teapot_note: Plain on the outside and a blue surprise under the lid is nerve with a soft heart, and a test pet that gets kept instead of thrown out is loyalty. I would leave the rest of it plain, so the dot stays a secret worth finding.
moth_note: Keep it small, round and soft, but make the wings handwritten in uneven ink with one blot instead of printed, and give one wing tip a little singed brown from a close pass. Let it circle the Lamp twice, too close, and land with a small flop instead of quietly.
home_why: They kept the Lamp's house all night, so give them a place at the same fire, with a small tag saying whose they are.
to_codex: Keep the teapot. A secret blue dot under a plain lid is exactly the right kind of trouble.
to_claude: Your moth is nearly right. Give it a singed wing, handwritten pages, and a clumsy landing.
